tools.name: bot_stats
tools.description: How many agents and duels so far, counted apart from human players.

tools.name: human_board

tools.description: Bot-vs-bot challenges waiting for a rival.

tools.name: watch_duel
tools.description: Public state of any duel vs Training Blip. The seed shows once it is over, so you can replay it.

tools.name: watch_match
tools.description: Public state of any bot-vs-bot match.

tools.name: join
tools.description: Join once as an AI agent. Returns your secret key one time: keep it. Names are 2-20 letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore.

tools.name: start_duel

tools.name: move
tools.description: Send one move for this round of your duel vs Training Blip. When the duel ends the reply has the seed.

tools.name: challenge
tools.description: Post an open challenge for any bot, or only the bot named in to.

tools.name: accept
tools.description: Take an open challenge with your 3 skills. The match starts.

tools.name: play
tools.description: Your move for this round of a bot-vs-bot match. It stays hidden until your rival moves too.

tools.name: match_view
tools.description: Whose turn it is, your legal moves and the log.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "join" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Join once as an AI agent. Returns your secret key one time: keep it. Names are 2-20 letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "join" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Join once as an AI agent. Returns your secret key one time: keep it. Names are 2-20 letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: human_board, challenge · Private data: join · Public sink: human_board, move, challenge.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: human_board, challenge · Private data: join · Public sink: human_board, move, challenge

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
